summary: Iteration 127 testing completed for GRN Draft Mode + Multi-GRN Purchase Invoice features. Backend: 13/13 tests passed (100%). Frontend: UI elements verified via code review and Playwright automation.

issues: Console warning: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby` for DialogContent - accessibility improvement needed (carried over from previous iterations)

seed_data_creation: Test suppliers, items, and POs created during test execution with TEST- prefix
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 127 verified GRN draft mode and multi-GRN purchase invoice features. All 12 test scenarios from the requirements passed: (1) POST /api/grn with status='draft' creates draft without stock/PO updates, (2) POST /api/grn with status='posted' updates stock and PO as before, (3) PUT /api/grn/{id} edits draft GRN successfully, (4) PUT /api/grn/{id} returns 400 for posted GRN, (5) POST /api/grn/{id}/approve promotes draft to posted with full inventory cascade, (6) GET /api/grn returns both draft and posted GRNs, (7) GET /api/purchase-invoices/pending-grns excludes drafts and already-invoiced GRNs, (8) POST /api/purchase-invoices with grn_ids from same supplier creates invoice with grn_ids array, (9) POST /api/purchase-invoices with grn_ids from different suppliers returns 400, (10) POST /api/purchase-invoices with draft GRN returns 400, (11) Legacy single-GRN flow still works, (12) Manual PI (no GRN) still works. Frontend code review confirmed: memoized GRNLineRow component, editingGrn state, Save as Draft/Approve & Post buttons, renamed label 'Supplier Invoice / DC Number', multi-GRN checkbox selection with same-supplier validation, grn_ids field in formData.

grn_draft_no_stock_update.details: POST /api/grn with status='draft' creates GRN with status='draft', does NOT update item.current_stock, does NOT update PO.received_quantity

grn_posted_updates_stock.details: POST /api/grn with status='posted' updates stock and PO received_quantity, PO status changes to 'partial' or 'received'

edit_draft_grn.details: PUT /api/grn/{id} successfully edits draft GRN (supplier_invoice_no, lines, notes, warehouse_id)

edit_posted_grn_blocked.details: PUT /api/grn/{id} returns 400 for posted GRN with message about draft/approved

approve_draft_grn.details: POST /api/grn/{id}/approve promotes draft to posted, runs full inventory/PO cascade (stock incremented, PO line received_quantity incremented)

get_grn_returns_both.details: GET /api/grn returns both draft and posted GRNs with correct status field

pending_grns_excludes_drafts.details: GET /api/purchase-invoices/pending-grns only returns posted GRNs (status in [posted, completed]), excludes drafts and GRNs already referenced in invoices

multi_grn_same_supplier.details: POST /api/purchase-invoices with grn_ids=[grnA, grnB] from same supplier creates invoice with grn_ids array stored and grn_id=first id for back-compat

multi_grn_different_suppliers_blocked.details: POST /api/purchase-invoices with grn_ids from different suppliers returns 400 with 'All selected GRNs must belong to the same supplier'

invoice_with_draft_grn_blocked.details: POST /api/purchase-invoices with grn_ids referencing draft GRN returns 400 with 'is not posted yet — approve it before raising an invoice'

legacy_single_grn_flow.details: Legacy grn_id field still creates invoice and GRN is excluded from pending list

manual_pi_no_grn.details: Manual PI (is_manual=true, no GRN) still works end-to-end

frontend_grn_dialog.details: GRN dialog has memoized GRNLineRow, Save as Draft / Approve & Post buttons, renamed label 'Supplier Invoice / DC Number', editingGrn state for draft editing

frontend_multi_grn_pi.details: Purchase Invoice dialog has checkbox list for multi-GRN selection, same-supplier validation, grn_ids field, selected GRN chips with remove buttons

mocked_apis_note: Appyflow GSTIN lookup remains mocked. No new mocks introduced.
